factors.name: pitches
factors.stated: pitches from 80 nm (k1 = 0.28) to isolated (2000 nm), with enough pitches to resolve forbidden-pitch dips

factors.name: x-dipole pole centre
factors.stated: x-dipole (pole centre 0.5 to 0.95, pole radius 0.1 to 0.2)

factors.name: x-dipole pole radius
factors.stated: x-dipole (pole centre 0.5 to 0.95, pole radius 0.1 to 0.2)

factors.name: conventional sources with sigma
factors.stated: for conventional sources with sigma from 0.1 to 0.95

factors.name: neighbour
factors.stated: a single isolated line with one neighbour moved from 80 nm to 2000 nm away for the ambit study

factors.name: defocus z
factors.stated: Defocus z in the resist-side medium of index n adds the pupil phase 2*pi/lambda * z * (n - sqrt(n**2 - (lambda*f)**2)) at spatial frequency f.

factors.name: mask line width
factors.stated: a one-dimensional OPC sets the mask line width at every pitch so it prints at 40 nm at best focus

quantities.name: depth of focus through pitch
quantities.stated: depth of focus at 5% exposure latitude with a CD tolerance of +/-10% of 40 nm

quantities.name: attenuated-mask side-lobe printing
quantities.stated: whether an attenuated-mask side lobe reaches the printing threshold

quantities.name: forbidden pitches
quantities.stated: Name the forbidden pitches of each source.

quantities.name: common depth of focus
quantities.stated: maximize the common depth of focus of a representative set of pitches (dense, semi-dense, the worst forbidden pitch, isolated)

quantities.name: CD change of the isolated line
quantities.stated: the CD change of the isolated line as its neighbour moves away

quantities.name: optical ambit
quantities.stated: the distance beyond which it stays below 0.1 nm

quantities.name: extent of CD oscillation
quantities.stated: how far its oscillation is still visible

quantities.name: Abbe and Hopkins aerial images
quantities.stated: Abbe and Hopkins both implemented, and their aerial images compared.

quantities.name: numerical error
quantities.stated: Report every number with its numerical error (grid, source sampling, focus step)

comparisons.what: Compare depth of focus through pitch across illumination sources and identify each source's forbidden pitches.
Compare NILS, MEEF, iso-dense bias, required mask bias, and side-lobe printing through pitch as the source changes.
Compare the optimized free-form source with the best parametric source.
Compare aerial images computed by Abbe and Hopkins.
Compare the isolated line's CD change and optical ambit as its neighbour moves away under different illumination.
between: conventional sources with sigma from 0.1 to 0.95

comparisons.what: Compare the CD oscillation with the stated mutual coherence function.

constraints: Use exposure wavelength 193.368 nm through water of refractive index 1.436 and a projection lens of NA 1.35.
Use a thin 6% attenuated phase-shift mask with dark-region transmission amplitude sqrt(0.06), phase pi, and the Kirchhoff thin-mask approximation.
Use scalar imaging with no polarization, and state plainly that at NA 1.35 it overstates contrast and depth of focus.
Use vertical dark-mask lines and spaces with a target line width of 40 nm.
Use a constant-threshold aerial image with no resist blur.
Anchor dose so the densest pitch prints at 40 nm at best focus.
Set the mask line width by one-dimensional OPC at every pitch so it prints at 40 nm at best focus.
Use 5% exposure latitude and a CD tolerance of +/-10% of 40 nm when reporting depth of focus.
Keep mirror symmetry in the optimized free-form pixelated source.
Use Python with numpy, scipy, and matplotlib with the Agg backend.
Implement both Abbe and Hopkins and make their aerial images agree.

Make figures showing depth of focus through pitch with forbidden pitches marked, OPC features through pitch, the optimized source beside the best parametric source, and CD change against neighbour distance for several sigma with coherence-function zeros drawn.
